scope: C02/W06 test-only Chrome recovery, own receipt RPC and versioned document Preview; no production release or real account deletion

source.followupDocumentationDestination: codex/simple-signup-preview only; keep tested phone-test source unchanged

deployment.buildInfoLimitation: Browser access to /build-info.json blocked; SHA evidence is Vercel Source plus Git, not a fetched runtime build-info response.

testTarget.name: moemoa-test
testTarget.serverUrlEvidence: Existing same-branch Secret presence only; original value deliberately not opened.

receiptMigration.intermediateFailure: Initial byte-exact hash check failed because SQL editor stored CRLF; no semantic difference was assumed without verification.

verification.limitation: Administrator transaction-local role/claims checks, not real Google or JWT authentication. No account identifiers or receipt values recorded.

documentPolicy.activationMethod: Test dashboard ran the configuration helper enable policy update with additional preconditions; no local environment file or CLI credentials used.

independentReview.scope: Old 10/9 signup compatibility, new switches default off, local build configuration and migrations not autoapplied; not a production approval

realUserFlow.twoPassReview: Prior records authorize A/B/C login and signup tests, not deleting their stored data. No separate disposable account or new allowlist hash located in versioned evidence.
realUserFlow.minimumNextUserAction: Select one existing approved test account whose MOEMOA test records may be deleted; review the documents and sign in with Google directly. Do not press account deletion yet. The Google account itself will not be deleted.
realUserFlow.scopeDistinction: Using an existing account proves new-version acceptance/deletion, not creation of a new Auth account.

actualScreenChecks.accountScreenObserved: Signed out, zero device records and Google button
actualScreenChecks.requestedAction: User direct document review and Google login; do not delete account yet.

rollback.sequence: Disable test signup/admission and new server/UI flags first; restore recorded prior document tuple and compatible Preview source, then reverify before reopening. Keep existing users, receipts, credentials and allowlist.
rollback.rpc: Additive read-only RPC may be left unused; no user data rewrite required.
rollback.warning: Source/config rollback cannot restore a completed account deletion.

notPerformed: New-document real Google signup or existing-account roundtrip
Actual account deletion or end-to-end Storage cleanup
Production deployment, master update or production database changes
New credential generation, secret extraction or allowlist replacement
Public UGC activation or full jurisdictional legal clearance
